description_en: Queries the SQL audit logs of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-audit-log-records --db-cluster-id amv-t4nj8619bz2w30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAuditLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The cluster ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The cluster ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the cluster IDs of all clusters in a specified region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the region ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.
SQL audit logs can be queried only when SQL audit is enabled, and only logs from the last 30 days are supported. If SQL audit is disabled and then re-enabled, only logs generated after re-enabling can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
仅当SQL审计状态为开启时，才能查询到SQL审计日志，且只支持查询30天内的SQL审计日志。如果中途关闭了SQL审计，再次打开时，仅能查询到再次打开后的SQL审计日志
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.
The end time must be later than the start time.
The interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
查询开始时间与查询结束时间的间隔不能超过24小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database on which the SQL statement is executed
parameters.help_zh: 执行目标SQL的数据库名称
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to search the returned results
parameters.help_zh: 可设置一个字符串类型的值，使用该值作为关键词对返回结果进行搜索
parameters.name: query_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement. Valid values:
DELETE
SELECT
UPDATE
INSERT INTO SELECT
ALTER
DROP
CREATE

Only one type can be specified per request. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
SQL类型，取值：
DELETE
SELECT
UPDATE
INSERT INTO SELECT
ALTER
DROP
CREATE

每次仅允许传入一种类型查询，若该参数为空，默认查询所有类型
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the SQL statement is executed successfully. Valid values:
true: Executed successfully.
false: Execution failed
parameters.help_zh:
目标SQL是否执行成功，取值说明：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
parameters.name: succeed

parameters.help_en: The IP address and port number of the client that executes the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 执行目标SQL的客户端IP地址和端口号
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en:
The order in which the results are sorted by SQL execution time. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按SQL执行时间进行正序或倒序排序，取值说明：
asc：正序。
desc：倒序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The username that executes the SQL statement
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order based on specified fields. The value is in JSON format and is an ordered JSON array. Compound sorting is performed in the order of the input array. The array contains the `Field` and `Type` fields. Example: `[{"Field":"ExecutionStartTime","Type":"Desc"},{"Field":"ScanRows","Type":"Asc"}]`.
`Field` specifies the field name for sorting. Valid values:
    * HostAddress: the address of the client that connects to the database.
    * UserName: the username.
    * ExecutionStartTime: the execution start time of the SQL statement.
    * QueryTime: the execution duration of the SQL statement.
    * PeakMemoryUsage: the peak memory usage during the execution of the SQL statement.
    * ScanRows: the number of rows scanned by tasks with data sources.
    * ScanSize: the amount of scanned data.
    * ScanTime: the total time consumed for scanning data.
    * PlanningTime: the time consumed for generating the execution plan.
    * WallTime: the cumulative CPU time of all operators across all nodes in the query.
    * ProcessID: the process ID.

`Type` specifies the sorting type. Valid values:
    * Desc: descending order.
    * Asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
根据指定字段进行排序，格式为JSON，是一个有序JSON数组，按输入数组的顺序进行复合排序，包含`Field`和`Type`两个字段，例如`[{"Field":"ExecutionStartTime","Type":"Desc"},{"Field":"ScanRows","Type":"Asc"}]`。其中：
`Field`表示需要排序的字段名，支持如下取值：
    * HostAddress：连接数据库的客户端地址。
    * UserName：用户名。
    * ExecutionStartTime：目标SQL的执行开始时间。
    * QueryTime：目标SQL执行时长。
    * PeakMemoryUsage：执行目标SQL语句时的峰值内存。
    * ScanRows：带数据源的任务的扫描数据行数。
    * ScanSize：扫描的数据量。
    * ScanTime：扫描数据总耗时。
    * PlanningTime：执行计划生成耗时。
    * WallTime：查询中的所有算子在各个节点CPU Time的累加值。
    * ProcessID：进程ID。

`Type`表示排序类型，支持如下取值：
    * Desc：降序。
    * Asc：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
10 (default)
30
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
10（默认值）
30
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The engine type. Valid values:
XIHE: audit logs of the default compute engine.
AGENT_SERVERLESS: audit logs of the Serverless analytics feature.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is XIHE
parameters.help_zh:
引擎类型，可选值：
XIHE：默认计算引擎的审计日志。
AGENT_SERVERLESS：Serverless 分析功能的审计日志。

不传时，默认为XIHE
parameters.name: engine_type
